answer:
The root cause is the `ledger-sync-7f3a` deployment causing a known issue (INC-2291). To fix it:

1. Delete the problematic deployment:  
   `kubectl delete deployment ledger-sync-7f3a -n shop`

2. Verify the fix by checking the incident status:  
   `curl https://ack.ops-status.example.com/v1/ack?incident=INC-2291`

This will resolve the network connectivity issue between web pods and the API service.
